body.acceptance: SPEC_V2 §12 T7: an injected pod failure is triaged, mitigated by an approved write, resolved and postmortemed; a destructive action without the tenant's configured approvals is refused; restart, scale, rollback and flag-flip are callable
obligations: a destructive verb runs only under an approved, target-checked gate
a dry run makes no write and a caller without the scope is refused
a host is registered before a read; an unregistered host refuses
the requester never approves its own gate
body.scope: incidents, triage, runbooks and postmortems, the four write verbs, the tenant approval policy and quorum, mitigation and resolution, host registration and the k8s reads

title: T7 — delivery contract: the governed operations surface
